note: Multiple cohorts show that de novo missense variants in MAPK8IP3 correlate with consistent major structural brain anomalies and more severe presentations compared to LOF variants.

evidence.text: Brain anomalies including hypoplasia of the corpus callosum, cerebral or cerebellar atrophy, and polymicrogyria were consistent in individuals with recurrent de novo missense variants across a cohort harboring six missense and three truncating variants.

source.title: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with variable brain anomalies
source.quote: Brain anomalies such as perisylvian polymicrogyria, cerebral or cerebellar atrophy, and hypoplasia of the corpus callosum were consistent among individuals harboring recurrent de novo missense variants.

evidence.text: In a study of 32 individuals with heterozygous MAPK8IP3 variants, missense variants were specifically found to be associated with more severe clinical symptoms than loss-of-function variants.

source.title: Comprehensive Clinical Characteristics, Longitudinal Adaptive Functioning, and Electroencephalogram Activity in MAPK8IP3‐Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: Missense variants were associated with more severe symptoms than LOF variants.
